messages:
lee_sales: FYI — two separate AEs just flagged the same ask: per-tenant API rate limits for Dedicated customers. Both want ability to set soft/hard limits and per-route caps.

sara_pm: Thanks Lee. Can you paste links to both customer notes? Want to confirm they truly match before merging.

lee_sales: Sure — convo A: https://acme.slack.com/archives/C123/p/1766330000
convo B: https://acme.slack.com/archives/C234/p/1766334000
Both mention per-tenant caps + webhook when approaching limit. Slight difference: one wants UI toggle, other wants API-only. Both said high priority for go-live in July.

chris_support: Noted. I'll add the support-facing template and ask for typical QPS numbers. Need that to size Dedicated pools and recommend defaults.

sara_pm: Ok plan: 1) Merge into single canonical backlog ticket 2) Capture both asks as customer examples + desired UX (UI vs API) 3) Label P2 / customer-request / needs-input 4) Assign PM owner.

jordan_eng: From infra perspective, implementation looks like: rate-limiter hook per-tenant -> per-route config -> alert/webhook. Complexity depends on persistence (redis vs in-memory) and whether we do soft limit (throttled responses + header) vs hard block. Rough estimate 3-4 sprints if we build UI + policy service.

sara_pm: I'm going to create the canonical ticket and merge the two ask threads into it. Proposed canonical: RW-871. Adding customers as reporters.

jira-bot: Created ticket RW-871 "Per-tenant rate limits + notification" · https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-871

sara_pm: Tagging draft Jira fields below — thumbs if these look right. If no objections I'll set priority P2 and tentative target: beta in Q3.

```
Summary: Per-tenant API rate limits + notification
Labels: customer-request, needs-info, infra-impact
Priority: P2
Owner: sara_pm
Acceptance criteria:
 - API + UI to set soft/hard limits per tenant
 - Webhook + header-based warnings when approaching soft limit
 - Docs + migration notes for Dedicated customers
 - Perf tests and e2e for failure modes
```

lee_sales: :thumbsup: Add both AE contacts as watchers and note the July timeline ask.

chris_support: I'll follow up with both customers for QPS numbers and expected percentiles. Also adding a note to include a helpful default policy for new tenants.

jordan_eng: One ask: do we want per-tenant burst tokens? That's an additional complexity and should be scoped as stretch.

sara_pm: Agreed — mark burst tokens as stretch. Will update ticket RW-871 with scope: MVP = API + webhook + basic UI; Stretch = burst tokens, per-route quotas in first release.

lee_sales: Please ping me when you post the customer-facing update (I will notify AE team). We should close the loop quickly since both asked for status.

sara_pm: Will do. Draft reply to customers: "Thanks — we've consolidated both requests into RW-871. We're scoping an MVP (API + webhook + basic UI) with target beta in Q3. We're collecting QPS numbers — your inputs would help prioritize. Assigning PM owner: @sara_pm." Any edits?

chris_support: Looks good. Maybe add: "We'll follow up with a short questionnaire (1–2 Qs) to confirm traffic patterns." Keeps ask low friction.

sara_pm: Added. I'll send update in 30m and flag RW-871 watchers. Action items noted: @chris_support collect QPS, @jordan_eng scope effort, @lee_sales notify AEs. Closing thread after update is sent.
